BeefLEAN 2 Lbs.
Flour½ Cup Pepper½ teaspoon Oil3 Tablespoons
Beef BrothDouble-Strength 6 Cups

Shortening3 teaspoons Flour1½ Cups Baking Powder2 teaspoons Salt¾ teaspoon Milk¾ Cup
Slice Lean Beef into 1&inch; cubes. Combine Flour and Pepper, then pour over Beef cubes until they are well coated. Peel Carrots and cut into 1&inch; pieces.
Peel Potatoes and cut into 1&inch; cubes.
Remove the Skins from the Onions, then slice in halves. Place each half flat-side down and cut into ¼
Follow instructions to prepare the Dumplings. Place Oil in Dutch Oven and heat from the bottom. Add coated Beef cubes then scrape and stir occasionally until they are browned. Add Double-Strength Beef Broth, Worcestershire Sauce, Crushed Thyme, Bay Leaves, Garlic Powder and Salt then mix well. Heat mixture to a boil. Add Carrots, Potatoes, Onions and Pearl Barley and stir well. Drop large spoonfuls of Dumpling mix around top of Stew.
Reduce heat from bottom and simmer until Potatoes are beginning to fall apart. (TODO: Determine about how long this takes.)
In a bowl, combine Shortening, Flour, Baking Powder, and Salt, then mix well with a fork. Stir in Milk.
The Dumplings are not required, so feel free to omit them if you want.
